environment.description: Node.js Apollo GraphQL server deployed on EC2 behind an Application Load Balancer with public DNS. The ALB forwards all HTTP traffic directly to the origin on port 4000. No CDN layer. Session store is Redis on ElastiCache (same VPC). The server accepts connections from any source IP. Health check path is /graphql?query={__typename}.

config.network: ALB public-facing, target group port 4000, no IP restrictions
config.tls: ALB terminates TLS, HTTP to origin
config.origin_access: unrestricted, ALB security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on 443
